home.headline: Tell us what you have. We'll tell you where it reaches.
home.sub: Every price here is the complete price for the party you tell us about. Nothing is added later.

hero.headline: The price you see is the price you pay.
hero.sub: Curated packages across the Gulf, the Levant and North Africa. Every figure on this site is the complete cost for the party you tell us about.

search.note: No destination needed. Most people do not have one yet.

featured.title: Three trips leaving soon
featured.note: Every card shows the total, the nights, the departure city, and what is not included.

pricing.title: We show you the bill, not the headline.
pricing.body: The industry writes “from 2,999” and adds the rest at checkout. We compute one all-in figure per person, server-side, with every mandatory fee already in it, and we tell you what falls outside it and roughly what that costs.
pricing.l1b: Computed for your actual party size and departure city, not a twin-share teaser.
pricing.l2b: Visa, tourist tax, optional excursions. Named and estimated, at the same weight as the inclusions.
pricing.l3b: No countdown timers. No “three people are viewing this”. If seats are limited the number is the real number.

human.title: A person, not a form.
human.body: Send the trip straight into a conversation. The package, your dates and your party come with it, so nothing has to be retyped.
human.name: Layla H.
human.meta: Arabic and English · usually replies within the hour, 9am to 9pm Riyadh

foot.rights: Specimen site. Invented packages, invented prices, no bookings taken.

story.c1: It starts the night before, when nobody can sleep.
story.c2: Somewhere past the third hour, the arguing stops and everyone just looks.
story.c3: You booked a week away. What you brought home was one dinner that ran until midnight.
story.c4: Nobody photographs the price. They photograph this.
story.turn: So the only thing left to get right is the number.
story.turn_b: Every figure on this site is the complete cost for the party you tell us about, computed before you ask. What sits outside it is named and estimated, at the same weight as what sits inside.

flight.heroKicker: Departures from Jeddah, Dubai and Kuwait
flight.heroTitle: The whole price, for all of you
flight.heroBody: Every trip on this page is priced for your party, with what it leaves out written next to the total.
flight.aBody: Someone drops a link into the family group, and nobody can work out what it actually costs until they call and ask.
flight.bTitle: Every trip here starts from a city in this frame
flight.bBody: The departure city moves the price more than the hotel does, so it is the first thing we ask you and the first thing you see.
flight.cTitle: What is left out is priced too
flight.cBody: Visa fees, the hold bag, the airport transfer nobody mentions. Each one carries a number and where that number came from.
flight.sharingNote: Prices assume two people sharing a room. Change the number and we confirm the real figure with you before anything is committed.
flight.nothingExcluded: Nothing left out at this price.
